claims: March Madness 2026 can be watched on TV via CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV from March 17 to April 6.
Final Four games are available on TBS, truTV, and via streaming on Max.
The 67 games are split across CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.
NCAA March Madness Live is the official app to stream all games.
NCAA March Madness Live may require a TV provider login for extended viewing.
Paramount+ streams games broadcast on CBS including the Championship with the Premium plan.
Max streams games that air on TBS, TNT, and truTV.
YouTube TV carries CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.
Hulu + Live TV carries CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.
DirecTV carries CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.
Sling TV offers packages for TBS, TNT, and truTV in Sling Orange/Blue.
Selection Sunday for the 2026 Men's Tournament is March 15.
First Four for the 2026 Men's Tournament is March 17–18.
Final Four for the 2026 Men's Tournament is Saturday, April 4 on TBS/truTV.
National Championship for the 2026 Men's Tournament is Monday, April 6 on TBS.
NCAA March Madness Live allows a limited preview of games before requiring a login.
